summary: Strict Final AH Close Capture: Final-Close Lock now requires a same-session source timestamp at or after 8:00 PM ET. A 7:55–7:59 PM intraperiod snapshot can no longer be locked as the final close. TAG500 performs a pre-close refresh near 7:59 and forced/retried post-close capture until 8:10; if no 8:00+ snapshot arrives, the state remains Research Only. No score or threshold retune; training remains gated by Final Snapshot Reconciliation from at least two independent sources.
